inlineContent.text: HeadwireWire owns everything both ends of the helper link must agree on: the 14-byte message
header and its kinds, the JSON payloads each kind carries, the encoded audio packet, the
pairing code and proofs, the TLS and TCP options with both keys pinned, admission at the
helper’s listener, and the Network framework wrappers that dial, listen, browse, and frame a
connection. It holds no app state and makes no decisions about which link to use or what to
show; the iPad’s session logic is
‘s, and the Mac’s capture, encoder, and input
injection are the helper’s. Parts of this module are derived from Sill, Copyright 2026 Noah
Saffer, licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0, and were modified for Headwire.
